tasks.title: Establish executable quality harness
acceptanceCriteria: Repository exposes validate and status commands
Controller state and logs are persisted
A boundary check rejects UI/server imports from domain
tasks.notes: Plan: scaffold the executable TypeScript harness, prove the quality gate, then commit it before the first product slice. Verifier findings (2026-08-17): initial checker accepted an empty/missing domain directory and had no negative proof. Remediated with an actual domain module, explicit web/server/storage import detection, and temporary-fixture rejection tests. Post-remediation evidence: npm run validate passed on 2026-08-17 (format, typecheck, build, architecture check, 3 tests). Final verifier PASS after atomic state update. Independent verifier sandbox could not write dist/index.js (TS5033); that environment limitation was not reproduced by the controller validation.

tasks.title: Create routines with deterministic scheduling
acceptanceCriteria: Daily, weekly, monthly and interval schedules calculate next due dates
tasks.notes: Plan: define pure routine scheduling in src/domain, test calendar rules, then add the first HTTP and browser-visible creation flow. Domain slice complete: daily, weekly, monthly, and positive intervals; immutable completion; pause status; end-of-month and leap-year tests. Browser preview accepts a routine and displays its domain-calculated next due date. API contract tests cover successful creation and rejected invalid or unsupported schedules. Verifier found the runtime schedule-discriminant gap; remediation is in progress. Pending: post-remediation validation, responsive browser evidence, harness audit, verifier, and atomic completion record.
